fields.name: SurfaceTemplate
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1BA1DB0 creates it as 0xFFFFFFFF (empty FixedString); bg3.exe+0x1B9D270 assigns it with the FixedString assignment routine bg3.exe+0x412E090 from [caller object+0x70]+0x10. The object at +0x70 has three arrays of 0x30-byte elements at +0x150/+0x160/+0x170, like SurfaceTemplate InstanceVisual/IntroFX/FX, and +0x10 of a GameObjectTemplate is its Id. Probe: the same value 0x3C200551 in all 15 instances.

fields.name: _Pad4
fields.evidence: Alignment of the Array pointer at +8; the creator does not write it. Probe: always 0.

fields.name: Positions
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes pointer, capacity (+0x10) and size (+0x14). bg3.exe+0x1B9D270 reserves and appends 12-byte elements built from floats 3, 7 and 11 of 0x30-byte source records; bg3.exe+0x1B9D9D0 walks it with stride 0xC comparing x/y/z with a box around a point and swap-removes the hits, and removes the component when nothing is left. Probe: heap pointer, capacity == size, 1..7.

fields.name: BoundMin
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1B9D270 and bg3.exe+0x1B9D9D0 store here the first 12 of the 24 bytes returned by bg3.exe+0x415C3B0(points, stride 0xC, count) after every change of Positions - a bounding box of the points. Probe: e.g. (52.78, 2.31, -367.1), consistent with a minimum against +0x24.

fields.name: BoundMax
fields.evidence: Second 12 bytes of the same 24-byte result (see BoundMin). Probe: e.g. (63.91, 2.49, -351.7).

fields.name: SubgridPosition
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1B9D270 copies 12 bytes from +8 of the record found by bg3.exe+0x70FB60 in the container at [caller+0x58] by the surface cell's region id; that record's +0x18 is used as the row width when turning cell (x, y) into an index, so it describes a grid / sub-grid and +8 is its world position. bg3.exe+0x1B9C300 passes the same record+8 on (bg3.exe+0x1BA0340) for entities that have the component. Probe: 5 distinct values such as (24, 0.76, -381), (-26.5, 15, -438.5).

fields.name: _Pad3C
fields.evidence: Tail padding to 8-byte alignment; never written. Probe: always 0.

open_questions: BoundMin/BoundMax are most likely one Script Extender AABound (two glm::vec3) - written as two fields because the brief's type list has no AABound.
SubgridPosition: the record type behind bg3.exe+0x70FB60 was not identified by name (AiGrid sub-grid / surface region); the name is a reading of how it is used.
SurfaceTemplate assumes the object at +0x70 of the caller is the SurfaceTemplate; resolving the probed FixedString 0x3C200551 in the live game would confirm it (should be a surface template id).
What the Positions are for: presumably points of spawned surface lights (SurfaceTemplate has EnableLightSpawning / SpawnLightTemplateID); the consumer was not read.
Creator defaults for the box read as min (1,0,0), max (0,0,0) from a small unrolled loop in the pseudo-code - may be misread, irrelevant for live instances.
